name: Divine Visitation
oracle_text: If one or more creature tokens would be created under your control, that many 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance are created instead.
blocked_sentences: If one or more creature tokens would be created under your control, that many 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance are created instead.

needs.what: a battlefield-wide replacement effect on token creation: when N creature tokens would be created under a given player's control, create N tokens of a different specified token id instead (same count, original token never created)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: ReplacementModel only accepts the events `self_enters`, `self_enters_tapped` and `self_enters_with_counters`, all of which apply to the card itself as it enters, so there is no way to replace an event happening to other objects. The `token_created` trigger event is the closest, but a trigger fires after the fact: the original 1/1 tokens would still exist and the Angels would be additional, which is a strictly different (and stronger) card than the printed replacement. No entry in `static_effects` alters token creation either, and the Angel token itself (`angel_4_4_w_flying_vigilance`) already exists, so the replacement mechanism is the only missing piece.
